text:
hanna: FYI scheduling a graceful-driver-reload + rolling node reboot across eu-west az5 on Fri 2025-08-22 01:30-03:30 UTC. Goal: apply GPU driver errata + NIC microcode. We'll aim to avoid mass cache cold starts by progressive KV warming and a short traffic-shed window.
omar: Important: try driver reload (rmmod/modprobe) on a canary node first to avoid full-node evictions if possible. Last time full reboots caused big p95 jumps.
hanna: Agreed. Plan: attempt soft driver unload where supported; if soft reload fails we fall back to standard reboot. Cohorts of 5 nodes per rack, stagger 10m between cohorts. Abort on >2 failed rejoins per cohort.
yasmin: Backfill strategy: pre-warm eu-shadow pools and stand up 6 hot standby nodes in eu-west-standby. Also warm model KV cache progressively: seed 25% right after each node comes back, then ramp to 100% over 20m to avoid stampedes.
sven: Networking: temporarily lower BGP local-pref for affected ToRs so cross-rack egress shifts slightly to other spines during flaps. Also enable interface dampening on impacted ToRs.
hanna: Runbook excerpt below. SRE will run smoke checks after each cohort. If p95 >240ms for 5m or eviction rate >3% we pause/rollback.
```
# abridged runbook
prep:
  set-hot-standby --pool eu-west-standby --nodes 6 --duration 4h
  enable-burst --type preemptible --duration 30m
  set-bgp-localpref --target <to r list> --value lower
  increase-kv-ttl --multiplier 2
canary:
  try-soft-driver-reload --node canary-1 || reboot canary-1
cohort-loop:
  for cohort in cohorts:
    cordon $cohort --grace 240
    drain $cohort --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir
    for node in $cohort:
      try-soft-driver-reload $node || reboot $node
    postcheck kvseed --pool eu-shadow --progressive 25,50,100 --interval 10m
    run smoke-tests --tags latency,queue,kv
post:
  restore-bgp
  demote-standby
  restore-kv-ttl
```

hanna: Cost estimate: standby + burst + extra shadow capacity ~ $1.35k. Finance signoff required. @opsbot please raise FIN ticket and maintenance INC.
opsbot: Created MAINT-13478 and FIN-7209. Notified finance@redwood and ops-oncall.
yasmin: Canary list: internal-loadgen, tenant-alpha, tenant-beta. I'll DM owners and move reserved/dedicated tenants off impacted racks into eu-west-dedicated-locked for the window.
omar: SRE oncall (sven) will watch tail metrics. If kernel shows repeated GPU driver oops on any node we abort and gather dmesg + collect-support-bundle.
sven: I'll post cohort health every 12m. Also enable route-fallback rule: if eu-origin queue latency >160ms for 2 cohorts, smart-routing will spill to eu-standby then to us-west as last resort. Log fallback events.
hanna: Communications: I'll publish a short customer notice tomorrow with dedicated callout for reserved/dedicated customers. Message: 'Planned maintenance Aug 22 01:30-03:30 UTC. Short, transient latency and task evictions possible. No data impact.'
yasmin: Quick test at T-45: run dry-run soft-driver-reload on a non-critical node and validate smoke tests.
hanna: Final readiness check at T-60. If green, start at 01:30 UTC. :white_check_mark:
